purpose: Reusable standard event-time schema for every scientific event (pivots, rekey, signal Models A/B/C, future acceptance/retest science).
notes: Not every event needs all delays. For immediate causal events all four may be the same bar/time as allowed by bar-close convention.
For delayed confirmation, known_time must be later than event_time.
action_time may equal known_time (e.g. close-known, next-open execution is the frozen convention).
Realtime components: event_time == evidence_complete_time == known_time == action_time.

anchors/pivot_high_low.action_time: bar i + window (after close); consume via apply_anchor_delay(pivots, window)

signal Model A.evidence_complete_time: bar i+1 close (no immediate close back below)
signal Model A.action_time: >= bar i+1 close (next bar open per convention)

signal Model B.action_time: >= bar i close (next bar open per convention)

signal Model C.action_time: >= bar i+1 close (next bar open per convention)

validation: src/mve/causality.validate_scientific_event_times() enforces field presence and ordering; tested in tests/mve/test_causality.py::test_scientific_event_schema_validation
